test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'of'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, the preposition '**of**' effectively shows the constituents or components of snail slime. It indicates what the snail slime is constituted from.
 
• '**Made of**' is a commonly used phrase which indicates the material or ingredients used to create something, in this case, the '**mixture of substances**' that forms snail slime.
 
• The use of '**made of'** suggests that the snail slime retains the properties of the constituents, aligning with the context of the sentence.
 
• '**Made of**' is preferred when we talk about basic material or ingredients which have undergone a significant change, which is applicable in this scenario.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Option 1' (for) **is incorrect because it is generally used to denote purpose or reason which is not the case here.
 
• '**Option 3' (up) **could have been used if the phrase was 'made up of' for indicating a constituent of parts or elements.
 
• '**Option 4' (upon)** generally describes a position or something which is the basis for something else, which is not the context needed here.
